about: M82: the one list of the AI tools the Your AI tools screen looks for, and how each is found. The shell reads it (app/src-tauri/src/aitools.rs: only whether an app with that bundle id is installed, whether a program file with that name is in one of the folders, and whether the project has that folder; it never runs a program and never reads any file's contents) and so do the pages (app/src/aiTools.ts: which tools are on this Mac). The ids are the done signal's tools (runner/src/donesignal.ts DONE_TOOLS). apps: bundle ids, also the app Put it in brings to the front. programs: command line program names. folders: the tool's own folder in a project. binFolders: where programs are looked for besides the app's own PATH (~ is the home folder). [verify] the bundle ids of Antigravity and the Codex app on a real Mac.
